headline: Good morning — an AI-led rout hit Wall Street and the ASX on Friday, while Australian unemployment jumped to 4.9% and property auctions slumped.

highlights.label: Wall Street rout
highlights.text: The S&P 500 fell 3.7% and the Nasdaq 5.3% on Friday as AI and chip stocks sold off.

highlights.label: Jobless jump
highlights.text: Australia's unemployment rate rose to 4.9% in October, with 43,500 jobs lost, putting the RBA's next move in doubt.

highlights.label: Auction slump
highlights.text: The final capital-city clearance rate for the week ending 15 November was 41.3%, one of the weakest results since April 2020.

tip.title: Start the day with a glass of water
tip.body: Drink a glass of water soon after you wake, then keep a bottle in sight on your desk. Having it visible makes regular sips a habit instead of a decision. Aim to refill it at natural breaks such as before meetings.

quote.text: Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
quote.author: Jim Ryun

items.title: Braze shares jump on Salesforce's US$5.66 billion offer
items.summary: Braze stock rose sharply after Salesforce agreed to acquire the customer engagement platform for about US$5.66 billion. The deal signals continued consolidation among major marketing platforms.

items.title: What Braze customers should know about the Salesforce takeover
items.summary: Rival Klaviyo has published guidance for Braze customers on what the planned acquisition could mean for them. It is a vendor view, so read it as competitive positioning.

items.title: Buyer checklist after the Salesforce–Braze announcement
items.summary: The article sets out what martech buyers should consider while the deal awaits shareholder and regulatory approval. Contract terms, roadmaps and integration with Data 360 are the main questions for teams on either platform.

items.title: Salesforce and Microsoft launch Copilotforce preview
items.summary: A new plugin brings Salesforce customer context and sales workflows into Microsoft Copilot and Teams, in public preview. It shows AI assistants becoming the front door to CRM data.

items.title: Dreamforce '26 announcements recap
items.summary: A summary of the main product announcements from Dreamforce 2026. It is older than 48 hours but remains useful context for platform roadmaps; no newer martech roundup was found.

items.title: Salesforce to buy Braze for about US$5.66 billion
items.summary: Salesforce plans to fold Braze's engagement and AI decisioning tools into Data 360, Customer 360 and Agentforce. Closing is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval and is expected in fiscal 2028.

items.title: Copilotforce links Salesforce with Microsoft Copilot
items.summary: Announced around Microsoft Ignite, the plugin offers more than 38 sales skills inside Copilot and Teams in public preview. It lets Microsoft 365 users work with Salesforce data without switching apps.

items.title: Salesforce to lead US systems-integrator export consortium
items.summary: Salesforce will head a consortium of American systems integrators aimed at global markets, with eligibility for priority government engagement. It points to a push to package Salesforce delivery capacity for overseas buyers.

items.title: Reports of another round of Salesforce layoffs
items.summary: Reports say Salesforce has begun a fresh round of job cuts about three months after the previous wave. The number of roles affected has not been confirmed by the company.

items.title: Dreamforce '26 product announcements in summary
items.summary: The roundup covers the headline launches from Dreamforce 2026. It is older than 48 hours and is included because no newer product summary surfaced.

sfstatus.statusNote: Third-party trackers show several Salesforce incidents in recent weeks, including a Data 360 degradation on 16 November, but nothing specific to APAC or AU instances was found.

items.title: Data 360 degradation logged on 16 November
items.summary: A Data 360 degradation began around 19:21 UTC and was still open at the last update seen. This comes from a third-party aggregator and should be checked on trust.salesforce.com.

items.title: Multiple incidents recorded on 12 November
items.summary: Four incidents were listed that day, some lasting hours, with a configuration change cited as the cause. Older than 48 hours, but it shows recent instability.

items.title: Service disruption listed by isdown.app
items.summary: A tracker lists a service disruption for Salesforce, and a separate listing mentions one lasting about 41 minutes. Instances affected were not confirmed.

items.title: Unemployment jumps to 4.9% in October
items.summary: The jobless rate rose from 4.7% to 4.9%, the highest since 2021, as employment fell by 43,500. The result surprised analysts and complicates the RBA's December decision.

items.title: RBA left in an uncomfortable position after weak jobs data
items.summary: Economists are split on whether the RBA's tightening cycle is over after the weak labour market result. The cash rate is reported at 4.85% after a rise on 3 November, though sources vary.

items.title: ASX falls as Australians miss the Anthropic listing
items.summary: The ASX dropped on Friday as the AI-driven global sell-off spread and local investors had no access to the Anthropic debut. It highlights how exposed markets are to the AI trade.

items.title: Victorian election polls show a tight three-way contest
items.summary: Recent polls list the Coalition ahead, with Labor and One Nation both in the low 20s on primary votes. The election date was not confirmed in the results found, so check the VEC.

items.title: Global shares slide on AI worries
items.summary: Asian and global markets fell sharply despite a strong Anthropic debut. The move is relevant to Australian superannuation balances and the local tech sector.

items.title: Supreme Court rejects Tamil Nadu's Cauvery shortfall plea
items.summary: The court dismissed a plea that Karnataka make up a Cauvery water shortfall pro rata in the 2026-27 distress year. The ruling affects water sharing between the two states.

items.title: Core sector growth reported at 10.9%
items.summary: A news analysis based on The Hindu lists record core sector growth of 10.9%. This is from an exam-prep summary and not independently confirmed.

items.title: India notes Shenzhen nuclear declaration
items.summary: India said it takes note of the summit declaration on nuclear talks among major powers. The summary is secondary, so details are limited.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty edge lower after a strong November run
items.summary: Indian benchmarks traded slightly lower in early trade on 20 November after gains the previous day. The Sensex had closed at 83,021.75 on 19 November.

items.title: Nifty heads for its best month since 2020
items.summary: The Nifty and Sensex have each risen roughly 10% in the first half of November. Inflation, the RBI's December decision and profit-taking are flagged as risks.

items.title: CM wants Visakhapatnam, Tirupati and Amaravati plans as growth blueprints
items.summary: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu told officials to ensure balanced growth across the three economic regions. Identified investments are to become actual projects.

items.title: Amaravati region projects and consultations
items.summary: A review reportedly found 48 projects worth ₹4.65 lakh crore under way in the Amaravati region. Eight sector round-tables are planned from 24 November to 18 December; this is from an exam-prep source.

items.title: Railway terminals reportedly approved for Amaravati and Visakhapatnam
items.summary: The Railway Minister has reportedly approved new terminals for both cities. Costs and timelines have not been released, so this is not confirmed.

items.title: Andhra Pradesh wins seven SVANidhi Samman awards
items.summary: The state took seven national awards at the ceremony held in New Delhi on 20 November. The awards recognise urban street-vendor support programs.

items.title: AP sets its sights on the next industrial revolution
items.summary: The report covers the state's push for advanced industries, including quantum technology in Amaravati. The publication date was not confirmed.

items.title: Wall Street asks what can rescue the AI trade
items.summary: Investors are questioning the AI rally after a heavy sell-off that followed the Anthropic listing. The slump pushed the S&P 500 into correction territory.

items.title: Nvidia's slide deepens amid reported SEC accounting probe
items.summary: Nvidia shares kept falling on a report of an SEC inquiry into its accounting, which has not been independently confirmed here. Another source put the Friday drop at about 14%.

items.title: S&P 500 now below every Wall Street year-end target
items.summary: The index sits under all strategist year-end forecasts for 2026 and is up less than 1% for the year. It underlines how quickly sentiment has turned.

items.title: Fed minutes hint at further rate rises
items.summary: Minutes from the Fed's October meeting suggested more tightening may be needed to contain inflation. Gold fell about 4% on the day, so it did not act as a haven.

items.title: Week ahead brings inflation data after Nasdaq's 10% fall
items.summary: The Nasdaq 100 lost about 10% for the week, its worst since March 2020. Inflation data and earnings in the coming week will test whether the sell-off continues.

items.title: ASX 200 falls 1.58% as tech and miners slide
items.summary: All 11 sectors closed lower on Friday, with information technology down 4.71% and materials down 2.15%. The index lost 5.39% across the week.

items.title: AI sell-off drives a seventh straight loss for the ASX 200
items.summary: The Australian market followed Wall Street lower, with weaker gold and copper hitting resource stocks. It extends a run of losses.

items.title: ASX drops as Australians miss the Anthropic listing
items.summary: The ABC's live coverage tracked the Friday sell-off and local reaction to the Anthropic debut. It is the main local session report.

items.title: Australian dollar slides on RBA doubts after jobs shock
items.summary: The Australian dollar weakened after unemployment rose to 4.9%, lifting expectations that the RBA may stop raising rates. No reliable AUD/USD level or ASX futures figure was found.

items.title: Global shares drop on AI worries
items.summary: Asian markets fell sharply, with Japan's Nikkei down about 5%. After Wall Street's Friday plunge, the ASX faces a weak open on Monday.

items.title: Auction clearance rate falls to 41.3%, second-lowest since April 2020
items.summary: Cotality's final combined-capitals rate for the week ending 15 November was 41.3%, with Brisbane especially weak. It is a sign of sustained buyer reluctance.

items.title: Auction market hits a new low as buyers thin
items.summary: The preliminary national rate of 44% was the lowest preliminary result since April 2020. Rates have been under 50% for around nine weeks.

items.title: Auction clearances hit six-year low as rates rise
items.summary: Higher interest rates are weighing on buyers and auction results. Weekly figures for 21–22 November were not yet available.

items.title: Australia's housing downturn worsens
items.summary: Commentary points to deepening price falls across the capitals, with one report citing an 8.1% drop over seven months. The figure was not checked against Cotality's own release.

items.title: Average clearance rate under 50% for a seventh week
items.summary: The weighted average has stayed below 50% for an extended stretch. Cotality treats rates under 60% as consistent with falling prices.
